I’ve been using this app and website for probably a decade at least. I share it with everyone and tell them to support it. Really happy with the newest version of the app.

Sometimes you come across apps where you can tell someone made it to genuinely help others and as a passion project. There is no data collection. You are not required to pay a subscription. It’s $20 for optional “lifetime support.” It’s even worded like that. If that sounds like a steep donation consider this:

1 There are so many sound scapes. At least 50 but I bet there’s more. Almost  anything you can think of: rain to dark creepy whispers to sitting in a coffee shop to walking in a forest. 

2 The soundscapes can be actual  recordings of real noises or generated or both.

3 The different tones are separated, and completely adjustable. Example: it’s the jungle, but you can turn down that one bug noise and it becomes YOUR perfect jungle. 

4 There are 10 fully adjustable sliders for EVERY sound scape.

5 The way it works never sounds like a loop and it’s not like some set amount of time where it ends and jumps to another one. It just keeps the noise going indefinitely with all the different tones that you chose. There are features surrounding this like timers and alarms like you’d expect but I don’t personally use them. 

6 Each sound scape has multiple creative presets for you to try. Even animating the sliders over time. It’s incredibly soothing waking up to the rain tones slowly adjusting as you are falling back asleep. 

7 It’s difficult to describe the perfect personalized sound massage until you experience it.

8 The newest version of the app has the greatest feature yet: you can download your personalized or some preset soundscape for offline listening… That’s right you don’t even need an internet connection anymore to use it. And it won’t cut out if your internet drops out. Absolutely incredible.

9 I know it has helped many folks. Diagnosed and not. 

10 Personally, it’s so high quality and useful I’ve donated to this app multiple times on top of the lifetime support because it is absolutely deserved.

In summary: it’s very high quality and clearly made with passion and kindness with no stipulations. 

To the creator, Dr. Ir. Stéphane Pigeon,
Thank you
